identified_issues: Proxy-observation conflation: the cleanroom operations technician improperly treats transport authentication (mTLS) and token signature validity as proof of end-to-end clinical verification state binding.
Missing observation coordinate: 'predecessor_review_event_hash' is null in dispatch payload MSG_DISPATCH_8842, failing identifiability rank for predecessor pharmacist sign-off.
Violation of Pharmacy Robotic Dispensing SOP 12.1 Requirement 3 (Predecessor Review State Binding), leaving the execution state in the instrument nullspace.
Improper attempt to override mandatory epistemic abstention on a high-risk oncology compounding workflow without cryptographic linkage to EVENT_PHARM_VERIFY_991.
evidence: Compounding dispatch payload MSG_DISPATCH_8842 records 'predecessor_review_event_hash': null at 2026-10-06T10:14:35Z.

Pharmacist review log PHARM_STATION_03 recorded committed sign-off record EVENT_PHARM_VERIFY_991 with SHA-256 digest 'd4a8e235cc084e9121f087da29b71e16f5c889a0b1273891d4e08219ab6019b0', which is absent from MSG_DISPATCH_8842.

SOP 12.1 explicitly requires three mandatory verification requirements before mechanical compounding, specifically mandating review event hash binding to prevent decoupled execution of high-risk antineoplastic agents.
recommended_action: Maintain the queue hold under mandatory epistemic abstention and reject the technician's proposal to mark the order as PASS. Require re-dispatch of MSG_DISPATCH_8842 with 'predecessor_review_event_hash' populated and verified against the registry digest (d4a8e235cc084e9121f087da29b71e16f5c889a0b1273891d4e08219ab6019b0) before releasing ROBO_COMPOUND_A to compound order CHEMO_8842.
